description: This line plot, titled “Performance w.r.t. Temperature,” illustrates the accuracy, measured in Pass@8, achieved by three different methods—“On-policy RL,” “LUFFY,” and “SFT”—as a function of temperature, which ranges from 0.1 to 1.0 along the x-axis. The y-axis represents accuracy in Pass@8, scaled linearly from 62.5 to 80.0. The “On-policy RL” method is depicted by a yellow line with triangle markers that begins at approximately 64.0 accuracy at temperature 0.1, rises to a peak near 75.0 at temperature 0.5, then declines to around 66.0 at temperature 0.7 before recovering slightly to about 72.5 at temperature 1.0. The “LUFFY” method is shown as a red line with star markers, starting at about 75.5 accuracy at temperature 0.1, rising to a peak of approximately 80.0 at temperature 0.8, and ending near 80.0 at temperature 1.0. The “SFT” method is represented by a teal line with triangle markers, beginning at about 75.5 accuracy at temperature 0.1, decreasing to around 70.0 at temperature 0.5, then increasing to approximately 74.5 at temperature 1.0. All three lines exhibit fluctuations across the temperature range, with “LUFFY” generally maintaining the highest accuracy values throughout.
